change.title: Restore the strict Rust 1.96.1 clippy source-gate contract
change.summary: Removes the Rust 1.96.1 clippy failures without changing product behavior: the rare confirmed-runtime Science stop failure payload is boxed behind its existing getter, the transaction stop target groups its boundary/runtime/port identity, test-only helpers leave the production surface, and mechanical borrow/boolean/cfg warnings are resolved. Two explicit dependency-injection fixtures retain narrow documented argument-count exceptions.

basis: Rust 1.96.1 Desktop and Gateway cargo fmt plus cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings passed
bash test/run-rust.sh passed with Desktop 567 passed and 41 approved ignored, Gateway 290 library tests plus one CLI integration test passed, and S0_LAYER rust pass
transaction-scoped Science stop owner/CAS, typed stop failure, native-exit cleanup, and source-boundary focused tests passed without changing registered test identities
fresh independent code, test-evidence, and documentation candidate reviews bound to the current base plus diff passed with zero findings at every severity
clean exact-SHA fifteen-suite GATE-SOURCE and fresh independent completion review remain required before source closure
